text:
Maya (CSM): Quick heads up — ArqNova's activity dropped pretty hard after the POC handoff. Calls to inference endpoints down ~68% this week, only 2 active users. Procurement noted a budget hold. Thoughts on renewal risk?
Jules (AM): Saw the same numbers in analytics this morning. Who's the exec sponsor now? I thought Leah was CTO but I heard she left.
Ravi (SE): I can pull logs and recent prompt sets. Maya, can you drop the customer_id? I'll look for errors or model mismatch.
Maya (CSM): customer_id arq_88. POC ended 2025-03-15. They were on hosted eval with model redwood-xyz v1.2. Leah left, new VP Eng is Samir Patel. Procurement flagged a "pause" on renewal. :eyes:
ops-bot: Renewal alert — customer arq_88 flagged: 60d usage decline >50% — priority=high :warning:
Priya (CS Lead): Let's escalate via Playbook A — re-engage the new VP + exec sponsor. Need a short enablement doc + a 30m demo highlighting latency/cost wins. Maya, can you secure an intro to Samir this week? We'll loop in SE to prep.
Maya (CSM): I'll request an intro today. Ravi — any backend errors in the last 14 days? Also need a small usage heatmap for the QBR.
Ravi (SE): Quick pre-check: no 500s in logs. Saw latency spikes on tail requests when sequence length >1024. They started sending longer chat histories after POC. Sample line: ```2025-03-10 12:03:21 - req_id=xyz123 - seq_len=1536 - p90_latency=1.8s``` Could be cost/latency surprise -> procurement pause.
Jules (AM): Good catch. We should prepare a 1-pager showing cost delta with prefix caching + 8-bit quantization enabled. Also propose a 60-day reserved trial on Dedicated for their heavy workloads so latency is predictable.
Maya (CSM): Plan: 1-pager + ask for Samir intro. Proposed outreach: friendly check-in + 15m to review usage and cost optimizations. If Samir doesn't respond, escalate to Priya to join.
Priya (CS Lead): Agreed. Tagging renewal ops for visibility. Also mark as "competitive watch" — we saw an RFP mention of ClearBeam last month.
Jules (AM): I'll draft outreach and run pricing scenarios against their average seq_len distribution. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone — I'll update thread with the intro and call notes once scheduled.
